flame_town.reentry.message: You can head back into Flame Town.
flame_town.exit_forward.refuse: {player}: No way. I can't just leave a town with monsters running all over it. Besides, it looks exactly like what I saw in my dream. There's no way I can go...
flame_town.shop.intro: Merchant: Hello. The Gakishonen broke my door, so the place looks pretty shabby, but have a look if you like. All the food got eaten. Sorry about that.
flame_town.shop.title: Choose an item to buy.
flame_town.shop.items: 100 slingshot balls, 500 yen. Cheaper than in Arkhaia.
Buster Blade, 24000 yen. The strongest sword.
Arrow Shot, 15500 yen. Shaped like an easy-to-use gun, it fires sharp arrows.
100 Iron Arrows, 2000 yen. Arrows for the Arrow Shot.
flame_town.dying_man.words: Person 1: Damn it... that monster bastard... how dare he kill my precious daughter... I'll never... forgive... him... I'd rather... go... with her...
flame_town.dying_man.after: Right in front of you, a person suffered, and then died.
That reality was too painful for {player}, who stayed there for a while with his hands together, crying.
flame_town.person2: Person 2: Oh, I'm so hungry... And this heat, too. Somebody do something about it.
flame_town.person3: Person 3: Oh, I'm so tired... What's going to happen to us...?
flame_town.child1: Child 1: Waaaaaah! I'm hungry! I want something to eat! Sniff, sniff sniff, waaaaaaah! Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaaaah! Mommy! Mommy! Where are you, Mommy!
flame_town.gaki.taunts: Hey, you there! Are you giving me a look like you wanna pick a fight?! Huh?!
Huh? Who the heck are you?! You don't look like you're from this town! Don't tell me you came to share food with these lowlifes! Well, whatever, killing is fun! Kyahahaha!
Youuuu! I'm super ticked off right now! I'm gonna kill you!
Oho. So you want to become a lump of meat too. Bwahahahahahaaaa!
flame_town.gaki.remains: What used to be a Gakishonen is lying here.
flame_town.gaki.defeats: Dammit! But you know, I've got plenty of buddies besides me!
Ugh, how dare you beat me... You'd better remember this!
Dang it! I lost! Me, I actually lost! Daaaamn it!
Gwah! Nice one... I'm no match for you... But it's way too early to relax!
flame_town.cleared: Traveler 1: Alright! We got all of them!

Traveler 1: You. You did great. Now, once the food rations arrive, the town should manage for a few days. Looks like the dragons and the rest have pulled out too. Thank you, really. We might not have beaten that many on our own.
This is just a small token of thanks, but please take it.
Traveler 3: There's a shop at the back of this town. They have powerful weapons there. But they're pretty expensive, so put this toward buying one. Thank you.
Traveler 2: Well, let's go home. This place is creepy, so let's get out of here! Hurry!
flame_town.person4: Person 4: Oh... so hot... so hungry... And it hurts, 'cause a Gakishonen beat me to a pulp...
flame_town.girl: Girl: I've decided! I'm leaving! I don't want to live in a place like this! I'm going to live happily and peacefully in the next town! Don't get in my way!
flame_town.joker: Person 5: You know, they made fourteen slots for us townspeople, but I think they made a few too many. Looks like they've run out of material.
{player}: Why are you so cheerful? And what nonsense are you even talking about? Are you the author or something?
Person 5: Ahh, don't ask about that part.
flame_town.child3: Child 3: Isn't there anything I can eat? Hmmm, oh! This! Oh well, it's just a weed, but I'll eat it raw! Better than starving to death!
flame_town.child4.thanks: Child 4: Thanks a bunch for earlier. I'm rootin' for ya. Do your best, y'hear!
flame_town.child4.rations: Child 4: In the end I got lucky and got some of the food rations, so I'm gonna survive on these for a while, no matter what. So I'm doin' fine. Thanks a bunch!
flame_town.child4.ask: Child 4: What am I gonna do... I'm so hungry I'm 'bout to die... Could ya give me somethin' to eat?
flame_town.child4.give: {player}: Oh, I've got a sweet bun. It'd be bad if someone else took it, so hide it while you eat. Sorry to the others, though.
Child 4: Oh, thank ya! As thanks, I'll give ya this weird marker I picked up the other day. Use it, okay?
{player} received a marker that shines in seven colors.
flame_town.child4.none: {player}: Sorry, I don't have any. I'm really sorry.
Child 4: Aw, too bad. Well, I ain't gonna force ya, so take care of yourself too, y'hear.
Such kindness brought a few tears to {player}'s eyes.
flame_town.person6: Person 6: It's just like back in the war.
flame_town.traveller1: Traveler 1: Those Gakishonen punks! I'll make them rust on my sword! You, chase off the Gakishonen around here too!
flame_town.traveller2: Traveler 2: You there! There are Gakishonen all over the town! Kick every last one of them out! Before the town fills up with dead people!
flame_town.traveller3: Traveler 3: We're about to take down the Gakishonen in this town! You help too! There are too many to beat alone!
flame_town.intro: There lay a town turned to ruins, in a terrible state.
Red liquid was splattered everywhere, and the townspeople wandered around in pain, searching for something.
And from somewhere, laughter could be heard.
{player}: Dammit! That Yokotank! He really did it!
